reason: I'd play with the free tricks, but I'm not putting my card into some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store when I can't find reviews or know who's behind it. 99 ₪ for an app also feels steep next to the free stuff out there.
objection: It installs from the browser, not the App Store, and I don't know who made it or whether the tricks actually fool anyone, so paying by card on their site feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: Real unedited videos of the tricks fooling people, plus reviews from Israelis I can check and a known magician or company standing behind it.
